Fasting plasma glucose (FPG): Baseline glucose status — ≥7.0 mmol/L = diabetes; 5.6‑6.9 mmol/L = pre‑diabetes
| Fasting plasma glucose | Baseline glucose control | ≥5.6 mmol/L = impaired fasting glucose; ≥7.0 mmol/L = diabetes. |

(b) Any one of: fasting plasma glucose 7.0 mmol/L or more; 2-hour glucose 11.1 mmol/L or more on a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test; HbA1c 6.5% (48 mmol/mol) or more; or a random glucose 11.1 mmol/L or more with classic symptoms.
